name: sapphireit/sapphireit-publish-guard
description: A pre-publish quality checklist for WooCommerce products, with optional server-side publishing enforcement.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHPCS (WordPress ruleset) and the retired-prefix guard.
scripts-descriptions.lint:prefix: Fail on any identifier that still carries the retired prefix.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what PHPCS can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run every PHPUnit suite. Without a WordPress test environment, only unit runs meaningfully.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: PHPUnit unit suite. No WordPress, no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Install WordPress 7.1.3, its wp-phpunit library and WooCommerce 11.2.1 for the integration suites, and write the test config. Database: sit_wcpg_tests. The suite drops every table in it.
scripts-descriptions.test:setup:floor: Install the floor environment: WordPress 6.5.11 and WooCommerce 9.0.0. Database: sit_wcpg_tests_floor. The suite drops every table in it.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration and security suites on the current target. PHP: SIT_WCPG_CURRENT_PHP, else composer's PHP. Run test:setup first.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:floor: Integration and security suites on the floor target. PHP: SIT_WCPG_FLOOR_PHP, else php on PATH. Run test:setup:floor first.
